description: This PHP source file defines the class S3MultiRegionClient, a specialized AWS SDK client handling Amazon S3 operations across multiple regions with additional caching and middleware logic.

classes.name: S3MultiRegionClient
classes.description: A client class extending AWS's MultiRegionClient to support multi-region S3 operations with region determination and caching logic.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Static method to define and extend constructor arguments, including regional defaults and cache configuration.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the client and setting up the region-determining middleware.

methods.description: Creates middleware to determine and cache the region for a bucket dynamically during command execution.

methods.description: Creates a presigned request for an S3 command, requires a bucket to be specified.

methods.name: getObjectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for an object stored in a specified bucket.
